info.name: MVMNT Vendor Payment Methods API
info.description:
The MVMNT API enables you to automate freight brokerage workflows by integrating
directly with our Transportation Management System.

Contact Support:
 Name: MVMNT Support
 Email: support@mvmnt.io

request.description:
Query vendor payment methods using flexible filter criteria with AND/OR logic.

By default, only non-deleted payment methods are returned (deletedAt: { isNull: true }).
Override this by explicitly setting deletedAt filter criteria.

Vendor payment methods define how and where payments are sent for a specific vendor.

response.name: Filtered vendor payment methods with pagination
